title: SLIT MEMORY
description: A living temporal textile built from the actual recent history of coupled ribbons. Pressing into the image creates persistent folds in the history lookup, so one gesture can bend, repeat or compress time without stopping the underlying system.

visual_finish.composition: ten luminous histories cross the frame horizontally with local compressed and repeated temporal knots
visual_finish.material_model: fine luminous filaments on deep photographic black with layered persistence bloom
